author: WebBound
description: xsw.tw (台灣小說網): desktop info page (/book/<id>.html) or mobile info page (m.xsw.tw/<id>/). ToC from the one-page desktop list /book/<id>/, emitted as mobile chapter URLs: desktop chapter pages hold only half the text. Mobile chapter text is plain, inline in an id=nr1 element whose tag changes per request (read from the raw HTML; under Force Hybrid a <table>/<select> wrapper triggers one raw re-read). Desktop chapter URLs from older versions are read from the mobile page. Metadata: selectors on the desktop info page, extractMetadata on the mobile one.
